note: Tone-locked response frames. {b}=baseline name, {d}=deliverable, {loc}=block locator, {s}=evidence status, {n}=note.

en.title: # Response to Reviewers (draft)
en.scope: Scope note: this draft accompanies a controlled revision of the organizer baseline `{b}`. It answers the organizer's comment summary point by point; quotations reproduce that summary, not the reviewer's verbatim report. No experiment, dataset or literature beyond the supplied materials was added.
en.accept: We thank the reviewer for this point and agree with it.
en.partial: We agree with this point in part and have implemented it as far as the supplied materials allow.
en.reject: We appreciate the concern; after re-checking the baseline text we respectfully retain the original statement.
en.clarify: We thank the reviewer for raising this point and clarify the wording below.
en.invalid: We respectfully note what appears to be a mismatch between this comment and the baseline text.
en.na: Recorded as not yet implemented in this baseline revision; see `evidence_pending.md`.

zh.title: # 审稿意见逐条回复（草案）
zh.scope: 范围说明：本草案对应组织方基线 `{b}` 的受控修订演练，逐条回应组织方整理的意见摘要。文中所引为意见摘要原文，不是审稿报告逐字全文；未新增材料之外的实验、数据或文献。
zh.accept: 感谢审稿人指出这一点，我们接受并已处理。
zh.partial: 我们部分接受该意见，在现有材料允许的范围内已作处理。
zh.reject: 我们理解审稿人的关切，但复核基线原文后，我们礼貌地保留原表述。
zh.clarify: 感谢审稿人提出这一点，现就其含义作澄清。
zh.invalid: 我们需礼貌指出：该意见与基线文本存在事实性出入。
zh.na: 本条尚未在本次基线修订中落实，详见 `evidence_pending.md`。
